candidates.source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (Central Registry of North Macedonia) — institutional portal
candidates.why_relevant: Root portal of the statutory registrar (ЦРРСМ). Hosts the Trade Register, Register of Other Legal Entities, Register of Annual Accounts, Register of Beneficial Owners, Register of Pledges and Register of Disqualified Persons. It is the master pointer to every statutory filing channel for MK banks, savings houses, payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment/fintech vendors, including unlisted ones that publish nothing voluntarily.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-rate crawl of the mk and en site trees for service and register entry points; treat as pointer inventory, refresh quarterly. For bulk/commercial use, negotiate the Distributive System contract rather than scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language web search on the registrar's Macedonian name, then snowball through site sections

candidates.why_relevant: Free public lookup of registration number (ЕМБС), tax number (ЕДБ), name, seat, legal form, size category, founding date and status (active / bankruptcy / liquidation) for any registered entity. This is the base identity resolver for every MK bank, savings house, payment institution and payments vendor, and the anchor key (ЕМБС) that links all other statutory filings.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted per-entity lookups by ЕМБС/name for a curated watchlist of banking and payments entities; store ЕМБС as the join key. Avoid bulk enumeration; use the Distributive System for volume.

candidates.source_name: ЦРРСМ — Објави на уписи за субјекти (publication feed of register entries / corporate change notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication stream of executed registrations and changes in the Trade Register, Register of Other Legal Entities and Register of Disqualified Entities. This is the highest-tempo early-warning channel for MK banking/payments: capital increases, changes of management and supervisory boards, changes of activity codes, mergers, new payment-services companies, branch openings, liquidations. Available for unlisted entities that never issue a press release.
candidates.legal_status: legal publication obligation of ЦРРСМ; published data explicitly restricted to personal, non-commercial use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily polling of the publications listing, filtered by entity name keywords (банка, штедилница, платежни услуги, електронски пари, процесирање) and by watchlist ЕМБС. Because of the non-commercial-use clause, store as internal intelligence only or license via the Distributive System.

candidates.source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на годишни сметки / електронска достава на годишна сметка (e-submit)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory Register of Annual Accounts and its electronic submission front-end. All legal entities, listed or not, must file balance sheet and income statement schemes here; medium and large entities file electronically and attach audit reports. This is the single channel that yields comparable financials for unlisted savings houses, payment institutions, processors and IT/POS vendors serving MK banks.

candidates.legal_status: statutory filing obligation; retrieval governed by ЦРРСМ tariff
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not attempt automated access to the submission portal (authenticated, requires XML signing extension). Obtain the filed accounts via the paid ЦРРСМ information services or the Distributive System, per watchlist ЕМБС and per year.

negative_findings.description: No free, machine-readable bulk download or open API of the Macedonian Trade Register or Register of Annual Accounts was found. Searches in Macedonian for отворени податоци / API / CSV on crm.com.mk returned only the statistical bulletin and the publications listing, both HTML-oriented.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk access appears to exist only through the contracted, prepaid Дистрибутивен систем and through BIFIDEX; free access is per-entity and explicitly limited to personal, non-commercial use.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The MK statutory-filing layer cannot be scraped compliantly at scale. The collection design must budget for a licensed channel from the start rather than assuming an open register.

negative_findings.description: The exact public search endpoint of the Регистар на вистински сопственици (UBO register) was not located. All results were news/announcement pages about its launch and upgrades, plus a support contact (rvs@crm.org.mk, +389 2 3288 602). Whether the general public can search it freely, or only obliged entities and authorities can, was not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: UBO register confirmed to exist and be operational; access tier and query URL unresolved in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership data on MK payment-services companies is a core deliverable of this cell; not knowing the access tier blocks planning and could mean an FOI or contractual route is required.

negative_findings.description: Several crm.com.mk pages returned only a title or a maintenance notice to the fetcher: the /DS/ ASPX pages (Дистрибутивен систем), the /en homepage, and the Статистички билтен page (which served a Macedonian 'service temporarily unavailable due to parameter updates' notice).
negative_findings.result_summary: Content could not be read; hypothesis is server-side session/postback rendering or transient maintenance rather than dead URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are exactly the pages that document the paid bulk channel and the sector statistics. A verification pass with a real browser session is needed before any of them is judged unusable.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a ЦРРСМ-published ranking of largest companies (equivalent to a '200 најголеми' list) derived from filed annual accounts. No such registrar publication surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the Статистички билтен appeared as a registrar analytic product; company rankings, if they exist in MK, are likely produced by media/consultancies rather than the registrar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes a hoped-for shortcut to ranked financial data on MK banks and payments firms; ranking-type intelligence will have to come from BIFIDEX screening or from media/consultancy sources in another cell.

negative_findings.description: No public interface was found that lets you list all MK entities by NKD activity code (e.g. 64.19 banking, 66.19 auxiliary financial services, 82.91) — the free ЦРРСМ search is name/ЕМБС-driven only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Building the full population of MK payments-sector legal entities from the registrar directly is not possible through free interfaces.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's rationale rests on the registrar revealing the full population; that requires either the Distributive System, BIFIDEX industry screening, a reseller dataset, or the NBRSM licensed lists as a proxy.

negative_findings.description: Register of Pledges (Регистар на залог) and Register of Disqualified Persons (Регистар на дисквалификувани лица) had usable Macedonian names but no clearly discoverable English-language landing pages or dedicated public search URLs in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed to exist via Macedonian sources and the DS catalogue; endpoints unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Both are useful risk-screening layers for fintech partner due diligence; they need a targeted follow-up on the Macedonian site tree.

coverage_gaps.description: The commercial terms, data catalogue and technical interface (API vs. web ordering) of the ЦРРСМ Дистрибутивен систем are not documented in anything retrievable without a session or a contract.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Contact ЦРРСМ (+389 2 3288 100, contact via crm.com.mk) to request the DS catalogue, price list and technical specification; in parallel, run a browser-session fetch of /DS/ pages to capture the public catalogue.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass did not enumerate the actual MK banking and payments legal entities (banks, савings houses, payment institutions, e-money institutions, processors, POS/ATM vendors) with their ЕМБС numbers, so the statutory-filing channels have no target list yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBRSM licensed-entity registers and the MSE listed-issuer list, then resolve each name to an ЕМБС via the ЦРРСМ basic profile search, producing a persistent watchlist keyed on ЕМБС.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although crm.com.mk serves an /sq/ locale and a material share of MK financial-sector actors and their communications are Albanian-language.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run the cell's core queries against the /sq/ site tree and in Albanian (Regjistri Qendror, llogaria vjetore, pronarët e vërtetë) to catch Albanian-only announcements and entity names.

coverage_gaps.description: How far back the Register of Annual Accounts and the publications feed are retrievable (earliest available filing year, whether pre-digital filings are scanned) was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ask ЦРРСМ for the historical depth of the annual-accounts archive and test BIFIDEX for the earliest MK financial-report year available.

coverage_gaps.description: The Law on the Central Registry restricts use of published register data to personal, non-commercial purposes. Whether internal market-intelligence use by a commercial firm falls inside or outside that restriction is unresolved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain a legal reading of the Закон за Централен регистар use clause, and default to the licensed Distributive System or BIFIDEX for anything beyond ad-hoc lookups.

coverage_gaps.description: Other statutory archive channels adjacent to the registrar were only touched (Official Gazette free-issue archive structure, the Public Revenue Office's published lists, the Securities and Exchange Commission's filings for AD banks).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend a follow-up pass to slvesnik.com.mk issue indexing, ujp.gov.mk published taxpayer lists, and sec.gov.mk issuer disclosures, mapping each back to the same ЕМБС watchlist.

brief: North Macedonia's statutory-filing layer is centralised in one institution: Централен регистар на РСМ (ЦРРСМ), which runs the Trade Register, the Register of Annual Accounts, the Register of Beneficial Owners, the Register of Pledges and the Register of Disqualified Persons, and publishes a daily statutory feed of registration changes plus a statistical bulletin. Because filing is a legal obligation independent of listing, this cell is the only reliable route to financials, ownership and governance changes for MK savings houses, payment institutions, e-money issuers and payments/IT vendors that publish nothing voluntarily. The practical constraint is access, not existence: free interfaces are per-entity and legally limited to personal, non-commercial use, there is no open bulk endpoint or activity-code browse, and systematic collection realistically runs through the contracted Дистрибутивен систем or through BIFIDEX, the registrar-owned Western Balkans portal that re-publishes MK statutory and financial data with regional comparability. The highest-value next step is to convert the supervisor's licensed-entity lists into an ЕМБС-keyed watchlist, after which the publications feed, the annual accounts and the UBO register become targeted, high-signal channels rather than an unnavigable haystack.
